name: Cart displays a single item with full details
description: Verify the cart page displays name, description, price, and quantity for a single added item.
precondition: User has valid credentials; fresh unauthenticated browser context.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`/`secret_sauce`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page).

test_steps.description: Click "Add to cart" for "Sauce Labs Backpack".
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "1"; button label changes to "Remove".

test_steps.description: Click the cart icon to navigate to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: URL is `/cart.html`; page heading reads "Your Cart".

test_steps.description: Inspect the cart line item.
test_steps.expected_result: Item name "Sauce Labs Backpack", description text, price "$29.99", and quantity "1" are all displayed.

name: Cart displays multiple items with correct per-item quantities
description: Verify the cart page correctly lists multiple distinct items, each with its own details.
precondition: User has valid credentials.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user` and add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" to the cart.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2".

test_steps.description: Navigate to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Both items are listed, each showing name, description, price ($29.99 and $9.99 respectively), and quantity "1".

name: [Discrepancy] Cart page does not display a total price (FR-02 gap)
description: Documents a confirmed gap between FR-02 and live application behavior: the cart page never shows a subtotal/total.
precondition: User has valid credentials.

test_steps.description: Log in, add 2 items to the cart, navigate to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page renders only a QTY/Description/Price table plus "Continue Shopping" and "Checkout" buttons.

test_steps.description: Search the cart page for any subtotal/tax/total text or element.
test_steps.expected_result: **Expected (Per FR-02):** the cart page must display the total price calculation for cart items. **Observed (Live Application):** no total-price element is present anywhere on `cart.html`; totals only appear later on the Overview page. Record as a confirmed FR-02 gap, not a script/tooling defect.

name: "Continue Shopping" returns to Products page and preserves cart contents
description: Verify Continue Shopping navigates back without losing cart state.
precondition: User has valid credentials.

test_steps.description: Log in, add 1 item to cart, navigate to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Item is listed.

test_steps.description: Click "Continue Shopping".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`.

test_steps.description: Re-open the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: The previously added item is still present; cart badge still shows "1".

name: "Checkout" button navigates to the checkout information page when the cart has items
description: Verify the primary happy-path transition from cart to checkout information entry.
precondition: User has valid credentials; cart contains at least 1 item.

test_steps.description: Log in, add at least 1 item, go to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Checkout button is visible and enabled.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html`; page heading reads "Checkout: Your Information".

name: [Discrepancy] Checkout button is clickable with an empty cart (BR3 not enforced)
description: Documents a confirmed gap: BR3 says the cart cannot be empty when proceeding to checkout, but the live app does not enforce this.
precondition: User has valid credentials; no items added to cart.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user` without adding any items; navigate directly to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page shows no line items; cart badge shows empty.

test_steps.description: Click the "Checkout" button.
test_steps.expected_result: **Expected (Per BR3):** "Cart cannot be empty when proceeding to checkout" — this action should be blocked. **Observed (Live Application):** the button is enabled and clicking it successfully navigates to `/checkout-step-one.html` with a blank form. Record as a confirmed BR3 gap, not a test tooling failure.

name: Removing an item from the cart updates the badge and cart contents
description: Verify item removal updates both the visible list and the cart badge count.
precondition: User has valid credentials.

test_steps.description: Log in, add 2 items to cart, go to the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2"; both items listed.

test_steps.description: Click "Remove" on one of the two items.
test_steps.expected_result: That item disappears from the list; cart badge decrements to "1".

name: Happy path: valid checkout information proceeds to Overview
description: Verify the core happy path of submitting valid, complete checkout information.
precondition: User logged in; cart has 1 item; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: Log in, add 1 item to cart, click "Checkout" from the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: On `/checkout-step-one.html` with First Name, Last Name, Zip/Postal Code fields and Cancel/Continue buttons visible.

test_steps.description: Fill First Name="Jane", Last Name="Smith", Zip/Postal Code="12345". Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`; no error message is shown.

name: Validation: empty First Name shows field-specific required error
description: Verify First Name is enforced as mandatory with the correct error text.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: Log in, add an item, reach the checkout information page. Leave all fields empty. Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: An error banner appears with the exact text "Error: First Name is required". URL remains `/checkout-step-one.html` (user is not allowed to proceed).

name: Validation: empty Last Name (First Name filled) shows field-specific required error
description: Verify Last Name is independently enforced as mandatory.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On the checkout information page, fill First Name only ("John"). Leave Last Name and Zip empty. Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Error banner text is exactly "Error: Last Name is required". User remains on `/checkout-step-one.html`.

name: Validation: empty Postal Code (First & Last filled) shows field-specific required error
description: Verify Postal Code is independently enforced as mandatory; documents a message/label wording mismatch relevant to OQ-01.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On the checkout information page, fill First Name ("John") and Last Name ("Doe"). Leave Zip/Postal Code empty. Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Error banner text is exactly "Error: Postal Code is required". Note: the live error message says "Postal Code", not the field label "Zip/Postal Code" shown on the form — record this label/message wording mismatch (relevant to open question OQ-01). User remains on `/checkout-step-one.html`.

name: Edge case (EDGE-01): submitting with all three fields empty only surfaces the first field's error
description: Verify validation behavior is sequential/first-invalid-field-wins rather than an aggregate list.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on a fresh checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On a fresh checkout information page, leave First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code all empty. Click "Continue" once.
test_steps.expected_result: Only a single error is shown: "Error: First Name is required" (validation is sequential/first-invalid-field-wins, not an aggregate list of all missing fields).

name: [Discrepancy] Whitespace-only values bypass required-field validation (EDGE-02)
description: Documents a confirmed validation gap: whitespace-only input is not trimmed or rejected.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On the checkout information page, enter three spaces ("   ") into First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code. Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: **Expected (Per AC5/FR-11):** whitespace-only values should arguably be treated as incomplete/invalid and blocked. **Observed (Live Application):** no error is shown and the user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. Record as a confirmed validation gap.

name: [Discrepancy] Special characters are accepted without validation error (AC5/FR-11)
description: Documents a confirmed gap: special-character input is not validated or blocked, contradicting AC5/FR-11.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On the checkout information page, enter First Name="John", Last Name="Doe", Zip/Postal Code="!@#$%^&*()". Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: **Expected (Per AC5/FR-11):** special characters should produce a validation error and block progress. **Observed (Live Application):** no error is shown and the user proceeds to `/checkout-step-two.html`. Record as a confirmed AC5/FR-11 gap.

name: Boundary: very long input in First Name field is accepted without truncation error
description: Verify and document behavior for an oversized First Name value.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On the checkout information page, enter a 300-character string into First Name, valid values in Last Name ("Doe") and Zip ("12345"). Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Document actual behavior: whether the app accepts the long value and proceeds to Overview, truncates it silently, or shows a length-related error. Flag any silent truncation or overflow/layout break as a defect.

name: Edge case (EDGE-03): non-numeric/alphanumeric Zip/Postal Code is accepted
description: Confirm the app performs only a presence check on postal code, no format validation.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: On the checkout information page, enter First Name="John", Last Name="Doe", Zip/Postal Code="SW1A 1AA" (UK-style alphanumeric postal code). Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: No format-specific error is shown; the user proceeds to `/checkout-step-two.html` — confirms the app performs no format/pattern validation on postal code, only a presence check.

name: BR5 on checkout information page: Cancel returns user to the Cart page
description: Verify Cancel on the checkout information page correctly returns to the cart, resolving open question OQ-04 in the affirmative for this page.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: Log in, add an item, reach the checkout information page (do not fill any fields).
test_steps.expected_result: Cancel and Continue buttons are visible.

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/cart.html`. The previously added item is still present in the cart (not cleared). This matches BR5 for this specific page.

name: Error banner can be dismissed via its close (X) control
description: Verify the error banner UI dismiss control functions correctly.
precondition: User logged in with an item in the cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: Trigger the "Error: First Name is required" message by clicking "Continue" with all fields empty.
test_steps.expected_result: Error banner is visible.

test_steps.description: Click the dismiss/close (X) icon on the error banner.
test_steps.expected_result: The error banner disappears from the page.

name: BR2: direct URL navigation to the checkout information page while logged out redirects to Login
description: Verify unauthenticated access to a protected checkout URL is blocked and redirected, confirming BR2.
precondition: No active session (logged out / fresh unauthenticated context).

test_steps.description: Ensure no active session (log out if needed, or use a fresh unauthenticated context). Navigate directly to `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to the login page (`/`). An error banner reads exactly: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-step-one.html' when you are logged in."

name: Happy path: Overview page shows item summary, payment info, and shipping info
description: Verify the Overview page's informational sections render correctly. Per RISK-04, no payment-method-selection UI exists in SauceDemo, so none is asserted.
precondition: User logged in; valid checkout information submitted.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Bike Light" to the cart, proceed through Checkout with valid info (First Name/Last Name/Zip all filled).
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with heading "Checkout: Overview".

test_steps.description: Inspect the page content.
test_steps.expected_result: Both items are listed with name, description, and price. "Payment Information:" section shows "SauceCard #31337". "Shipping Information:" section shows "Free Pony Express Delivery!". Note: do not assert on a payment-method picker (per RISK-04, SauceDemo has no such UI) — only assert on the static payment info text.

name: Happy path: Overview page calculates item total, tax, and grand total correctly for a multi-item cart
description: Verify financial calculation correctness on the Overview page — a business-critical calculation.
precondition: User logged in; valid checkout information submitted.

test_steps.description: Add Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99) to the cart and proceed to the Overview page with valid checkout info.
test_steps.expected_result: "Item total:" reads "$39.98" (sum of item prices).

test_steps.description: Inspect the Tax line.
test_steps.expected_result: "Tax:" reads a value consistent with the site's tax rate (observed $3.20, i.e. 8% of item total).

test_steps.description: Inspect the Total line.
test_steps.expected_result: "Total:" reads the sum of item total + tax (observed "$43.18").

name: [Discrepancy] Cancel on the Overview page redirects to Products, not Cart (BR5)
description: Documents a confirmed contradiction between BR5's literal wording and live application behavior on the Overview page.
precondition: User logged in; on the Overview page via a valid checkout flow.

test_steps.description: Reach the Overview page (`/checkout-step-two.html`) via a valid checkout flow with at least 1 item in the cart.
test_steps.expected_result: Cancel and Finish buttons are visible.

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel".
test_steps.expected_result: **Expected (Per BR5):** "...return to cart" — should redirect to `/cart.html`. **Observed (Live Application):** redirects to `/inventory.html` (Products page) instead. Record as a confirmed BR5 wording/implementation mismatch.

test_steps.description: Verify cart contents after the redirect.
test_steps.expected_result: The cart item count is preserved (not cleared) despite the redirect target difference.

name: Happy path: Finish button on the Overview page completes the order
description: Verify the Finish action correctly transitions to order completion.
precondition: User logged in; on the Overview page via a valid checkout flow.

test_steps.description: Reach the Overview page via a valid checkout flow.
test_steps.expected_result: Finish button is visible and enabled.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`.

name: Happy path: confirmation page shows success message and Back Home button
description: Verify the order confirmation page content matches AC4.
precondition: User logged in; full checkout flow completed.

test_steps.description: Complete a full checkout flow (login -> add item -> cart -> valid checkout info -> Overview -> Finish).
test_steps.expected_result: On `/checkout-complete.html` with heading "Checkout: Complete!". Text "Thank you for your order!" is displayed. Supporting text "Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!" is displayed. A "Back Home" button is visible.

name: "Back Home" button returns the user to the Products page
description: Verify the Back Home navigation control.
precondition: User is on the order confirmation page.

test_steps.description: From the order confirmation page, click "Back Home".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`. Page heading reads "Products".

name: BR4: cart is cleared after order confirmation
description: Verify BR4 (cart clearing) is correctly implemented — data integrity check.
precondition: User logged in; cart has 2 items.

test_steps.description: Complete a full checkout flow with 2 items in the cart, through to `/checkout-complete.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge on the confirmation page shows empty (no numeric badge).

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home" and open the cart page.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page shows zero line items, confirming BR4 is correctly implemented.

name: [Discrepancy] Direct URL navigation to checkout information page with an empty cart while logged in (EDGE-04)
description: Documents a confirmed BR3 gap consistent with MTC-006, exercised via direct URL navigation instead of the button click.
precondition: User logged in; no items added to cart.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`. Do not add any items. Navigate directly to `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html`.
test_steps.expected_result: **Expected (Per BR3):** this should ideally be blocked/redirected given the empty cart. **Observed (Live Application):** the checkout information form loads normally with an empty cart badge. Record as a confirmed BR3 gap consistent with MTC-006.

name: Edge case (EDGE-05, Technical Notes): browser Back button from Overview clears entered checkout info but preserves cart
description: Documents undocumented-but-observed browser back-button behavior, per the Technical Notes reference with no corresponding AC/BR.
precondition: User logged in; cart has 1 item.

test_steps.description: Log in, add 1 item, proceed through checkout info (First Name="Jane", Last Name="Smith", Zip="12345") to the Overview page.
test_steps.expected_result: On `/checkout-step-two.html` with the item and totals shown.

test_steps.description: Use the browser's Back navigation (not the in-page Cancel button).
test_steps.expected_result: Returns to `/checkout-step-one.html`. First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code fields are all empty (previously entered values are not restored) — record this as expected/actual behavior for the back-button, since no AC/BR defines it explicitly.

test_steps.description: Check the cart badge.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge still shows the item added earlier (cart contents are not lost by the back navigation).

name: Full end-to-end happy-path regression: Cart -> Checkout Info -> Overview -> Confirmation (AC1 through AC4 chained)
description: Primary end-to-end regression chaining every checkout stage; the single highest-value smoke test for the whole feature.
precondition: User has valid credentials; fresh unauthenticated browser context.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`/`secret_sauce`.
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/inventory.html`.

test_steps.description: Add "Sauce Labs Backpack" and "Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket" to the cart.
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2".

test_steps.description: Open the cart page and verify both items are listed, then click "Checkout".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Fill First Name="Alex", Last Name="Rivera", Zip="90210", and click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with no validation errors.

test_steps.description: Verify the Overview page shows both items, payment/shipping info, and a total of item total ($79.98) plus tax, then click "Finish".
test_steps.expected_result: Redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Verify the success message and click "Back Home".
test_steps.expected_result: "Thank you for your order!" is shown before navigating. After clicking, redirected to `/inventory.html` and the cart is empty, completing the full regression path.

name: BR1: all three checkout information fields are individually mandatory (combined verification)
description: Combined verification that each of the three mandatory fields is independently enforced regardless of the state of the other two.
precondition: User logged in; item in cart; on checkout information page.

test_steps.description: Reach the checkout information page with an item in the cart. Attempt to submit with only Zip/Postal Code filled (First Name and Last Name empty).
test_steps.expected_result: Error: "Error: First Name is required" is shown (first missing mandatory field in DOM order), confirming First Name is enforced as mandatory even when a later field is filled.

test_steps.description: Fill First Name, leave Last Name empty, keep Zip filled. Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Error: "Error: Last Name is required" is shown, confirming Last Name is independently mandatory regardless of Zip being filled.

test_steps.description: Fill First Name and Last Name, clear Zip/Postal Code. Click "Continue".
test_steps.expected_result: Error: "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown, confirming all three fields are independently mandatory per BR1.

name: NFR-01: Cross-browser regression of the full checkout flow
description: Repeats the MTC-029 end-to-end regression on each browser named in NFR-01.
precondition: Browser test infrastructure available for Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

test_steps.description: Repeat the MTC-029 end-to-end regression flow on the latest stable version of Chrome.
test_steps.expected_result: All steps of MTC-029 pass identically on Chrome.

test_steps.description: Repeat on the latest stable version of Firefox.
test_steps.expected_result: All steps of MTC-029 pass identically on Firefox.

test_steps.description: Repeat on the latest stable version of Safari.
test_steps.expected_result: All steps of MTC-029 pass identically on Safari.

name: NFR-02: Mobile-responsive checkout regression
description: Repeats the MTC-029 end-to-end regression at common responsive breakpoints.
precondition: Device/viewport emulation infrastructure available.

test_steps.description: Repeat the MTC-029 end-to-end regression flow at a mobile-portrait viewport.
test_steps.expected_result: All checkout steps remain usable and visually correct; no layout breakage.

test_steps.description: Repeat at a mobile-landscape viewport.
test_steps.expected_result: Same as above.

test_steps.description: Repeat at a tablet viewport.
test_steps.expected_result: Same as above.

name: NFR-03: Usability — clear feedback at each step
description: NFR-03 states the checkout process "should be intuitive, with clear feedback provided at each step" but defines no objective, measurable acceptance criterion.
precondition: None beyond those of the referenced test cases.

test_steps.description: Review the error/feedback messaging already exercised in MTC-009, MTC-010, MTC-011, MTC-012, MTC-018, MTC-020, and MTC-024.
test_steps.expected_result: Each transition in the checkout flow surfaces a visible confirmation or error message (covered by the referenced test cases). No separate objective usability metric exists to test against.

name: NFR-04: Security of the checkout process
description: NFR-04 states the checkout process "should be secure" but the requirement document defines no concrete security requirement, data-handling rule, or acceptance criterion (see RISK-01, OQ-06).
precondition: None.

test_steps.description: Attempt to identify any documented security acceptance criterion (e.g., HTTPS enforcement, session handling, input sanitization) in the Requirement Analysis Report.
test_steps.expected_result: None found — confirms the gap already flagged as RISK-01/OQ-06.
